_about: Role words common in process industries (refining, chemicals, gas, storage terminals): permit and isolation roles, alarm and safety-system roles, relief and integrity roles, management of change, turnaround planning and tank-farm operations. Method reference, not evidence about any incident. Apply with: pmlc.py classify <ws> --industry process. Each regex is OR-ed onto the base rule with the same ID, exactly as an --overlay is.
name: industry:process

entities.F01: tank[- ]?farm|loading (bay|gantry)|unloading|board operator|outside operator|field operator|unit supervisor|operations shift|shift handover
entities.F05: relief (valve|device|system)|\bpsv\b|pressure safety valve|corrosion under insulation|\bcui\b|risk[- ]based inspection|\brbi\b|heat exchanger|pressure vessel|tank gaug
entities.F07: process hazard|\bpha\b|\bhazop\b|\blopa\b|process safety information|\bpsi\b|design authority|flare system|management of change
